lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca8Ce4Zr4O24 (reduced formula Ca2CeZrO6) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Ca and Zr centers, each with six O neighbors, and eight-coordinate Ce centers surrounded by eight O neighbors. The O-centered environments are octahedral, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-sharing between Ca and Zr octahedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Ce and Zr polyhedra.
